text:
Jordan: Quick capture — after yesterday's onboarding batch with NovaHealth and BrightBridge, several asks came up around route-level cost visibility and embeddings freshness. Starting a tiny sampler to collect structured signals for product. Can folks paste any asks they've heard here? I'll drop a template sheet.

Jordan: sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ExampleLink - use the 'signal-sampler' tab and add one row per ask.

Priya: From NovaHealth call: they want an endpoint-level metering toggle to pause expensive routes during trials. They called it 'trial budget guard' — stopping high-cost reranking while keeping core chat live.

Marco: BrightBridge wanted a realtime reindex / refresh API for embeddings. Right now they re-upload whole blob; it breaks search relevance for small teams.

Aisha: Two customers (small fintechs) were confused by the console's 'expected latency' label per model variant. They assumed it was guaranteed SLO and set alerts wrongly during onboarding. UX clarification would help.

Jordan: Thinking of capture columns: customer | ask | why (pain) | frequency (how often seen) | severity (1-5) | reporter | raw-note-link. Example row: NovaHealth | trial budget guard (endpoint toggle) | trial costs spiking, blocking rollout | seen in 3 onboarding calls | 4 | Priya | link.

Priya: +1 on severity scale. Mark NovaHealth as 4 (renewal-sensitive).

CSBot: Heads-up — if this ask is tied to an outage or billing dispute, add the `incident` tag so Finance/Support can pick it up.

Marco: I'll paste the transcript excerpt and a quick repro for the refresh API request into the sheet and tag it "onboard-feb".

Aisha: Flag: small customers misunderstand 'burst capacity' and think it's included in trial credits. Suggest adding a tooltip in trial emails and a short FAQ blurb in onboarding flows.

Jordan: Great, can everyone add rows by EOD? I'll synthesize top 3 engineering asks + suggested tradeoffs and ping @product on Wed. :thumbsup: 

Priya: Will do. Also if anyone hears the 'billing confusion' repeatedly, drop a quick sample quote in the notes column (helps product craft messaging).

Marco: Added BrightBridge's ask and severity=3.

Aisha: Added the latency confusion notes and linked the recording.

Jordan: Thanks — I'll do an initial prioritization rubric: impact on renewal / number of customers affected / engineering complexity. Sharing it after synthesis.
